newsitem.title: USA: Time Warner sees strong growth - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Time Warner sees strong growth - WSJ.

text.p: In an interview conducted Thursday and published in Friday's Wall Street Journal, Time Warner Inc chairman Gerald Levin said the company's cash flow would increase at a "very solid double digit" rate this year.
Levin told the Journal the company will have the "highest growth rate in Time Warner history."
This was despite Levin's prediction that the company's Warner Music group would have a flat year, the story said.
Levin was also quoted as saying the integration of the $7.6 billion purchase of Turner Broadcasting System Inc TBSa.A had "gone much better and faster than even we thought it would."
